findings.mechanism: Pool size (20) plus overflow (10) yields a maximum of 30 DB connections, which is below the concurrency ceiling implied by 4 uvicorn workers each capable of handling ~10 async requests. This violates the "Pool size against the real concurrency ceiling" rule from the reference material, leading to active_connections exceeding the pool and worker saturation.
findings.remediation: Increase pool_size to at least 40 (workers * expected concurrent requests per worker) and optionally raise max_overflow, e.g., set pool_size=40, max_overflow=10.
findings.arithmetic: workers=4; assume each worker can handle 10 concurrent async requests => needed_connections=4*10=40. Configured pool_size+max_overflow=20+10=30. Shortfall=40-30=10. Therefore active_connections will reach 30, and 10 requests will wait, giving worker_saturation=30/40=0.75.
